title: A simple improvement of the conventional cryopreservation for human ES and iPS cells
protocol: Remove the differentiated area completely by using the Pasteur pipette in advance.
Examine all the plates containing hES/iPS Cells by inverted phase-contrast microscopy.
Label cryogenic vials with the name of the cell line, passage number, lot number and the date.
Remove the culture medium from flasks.
Add 1.5 ml dispase (1U/ml) per T25 flask and incubate for 2-5 min until the edges of the colonies start to curl.
Gently scrape with scraper and pipette with 10 ml pipette so as not to break into small clumps.
Transfer to a 15 ml centrifuge tube and spin at 20 X g, 2 min, 4 °C.
Centrifuge the sample at low g forces (20 x g) to prevent feeder cells from collecting at the bottom of the tube.
Aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Gently finger tap the tube to disperse the pellet.
Resuspend the cells in freshly prepared ice-cold freezing medium (10% DMSO/culture medium).
Transfer 200 μl aliquots into each labeled cryogenic vial.
Place the vials on ice for a few minutes.
Store them in the freezing container (BICELL or Mr.Frosty®) and keep it in a -80 °C deep freezer overnight.
Next day transfer the vials to the liquid nitrogen tank (in the vapor phase, -150 °C).
Abort long-term storage in a -80 °C deep freezer if it exceeds 7 days after transferring from liquid nitrogen tank.
Store cells indefinitely in the vapor phase of liquid nitrogen.
Document the details of vials and storage location in the appropriate inventory.
Coat flasks with 0.1% gelatin at a volume of 3 ml per 25 cm² flask.
Incubate coated flasks for 1 hour at 37 °C or overnight at room temperature.
Rinse flasks with PBS.
Inoculate mitomycin c-treated primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts (PMEF) at a density of 5-7x10^3 cells/cm² in DMEM high glucose containing 10% heat-inactivated FBS.
Replace the medium with human pluripotent cell medium twice prior to using feeder-seeded flasks.
Pre-warm 10 ml of human pluripotent cell medium in a 15 ml tube at 37 °C.
Rapidly thaw frozen cells by adding pre-warmed medium directly into the vial using a transfer pipette.
Gently collect cells in the 15 ml tube and wash vial with pre-warmed medium.
Centrifuge the tube at 90x g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the medium and finger tap the tube gently to disperse the pellet.
Resuspend the cells in 5-7 ml of pre-warmed culture medium and transfer into a 25 cm² flask.
Gently move the flask several times along horizontal and vertical directions to distribute the cells evenly.
Incubate the flasks at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO₂.
Exchange culture medium every other day until hES/hiPS cells are ready for passaging.
Do not move the flask on the day following the passaging.
Remove the culture medium and rinse colonies once with PBS for 1 minute at room temperature.
Fix the colonies with fixation buffer for 1 minute at room temperature.
Wash colonies twice with distilled deionized water (DDW).
Start color reaction by incubating in reaction buffer, blocking off light.
Stop the reaction after 15 minutes by washing twice with DDW.
Count the stained colonies.
